messages:
elaine_support: FYI AcmeFin escalated — they see 401s on generation endpoint and a few spikes in latency. They attached a sample prompt that contains an SSN. Need repro bundle + sanitized prompt. Request IDs mentioned: req_63a7b1f2, req_63a7b20f. Can we gather logs and a scrubbed curl?

sam_oncall: Ok. Can someone capture the exact time window (their local times were ~2026-03-16 18:02:xx UTC). I need gateway + router logs around req_63a7b1f2. Run the debug collector with scrub flag if possible.

mike_eng: I can take the repro once we have a sanitized prompt + the request id. Quick curl template for them to run (replace <REDACTED_API_KEY>):

```bash
curl -sS https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \n  -H "Authorization: Bearer <REDACTED_API_KEY>" \n  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \n  -d '{"model":"rwd-llama-13b","input":"<SANITIZED_PROMPT>","max_tokens":150}'
```

Make sure they replace any emails/SSNs with placeholders (see Olivia).

olivia_privacy: Do NOT accept raw SSNs or credit card numbers in public ticket attachments. If the customer insists they need us to see originals, get explicit consent and use the secure upload link. For reproductions we require: replace SSN -> "REDACTED_SSN", emails -> "<EMAIL_REMOVED>", phone numbers -> "<PHONE_REMOVED>". Also include a short mapping file (locally) so we can rehydrate if we have consent. :lock:

jordan_support: I'll ask the customer to: 1) run the curl above with a throwaway key we provide, 2) submit the sanitized prompt in the thread, 3) upload the debug bundle to our secure share. I'll include the two request ids and the exact UTC times.

deploy-bot: debug-bundle created: dbg-20260316-1794001240 (secure link posted to ticket). Note: bundle contains request headers, router logs, and token counts. Scrubbed flag: true.

ryan_sre: For latency spikes also grab: kernel dmesg (last 30m), nstat/netstat, and the runtime _kv cache_ metrics. Command we use on nodes: `rdb-cli collect --req req_63a7b1f2 --include=kvcache,router,dmesg --scrub --out ./dbg-1794001240-scrubbed.tar.gz`

elaine_support: Thanks team. Action items: Jordan -> customer steps + upload. Sam -> pull gateway logs and handoff to Mike. Olivia -> privacy review once sanitized bundle is in. Ryan -> confirm what node-level logs we need and add to bundle. I'll update ticket and mark as P1 until repro confirmed. :white_check_mark:
